result.summary:
Independently verified design doc (lib/letflow/design/iss0785-attachment-instance-check.md) against ISS-0785.yaml and actual source files. All 8 criteria pass.

C1 (All ACs covered): §8 AC mapping table covers every item from ISS-0785.yaml description and suggested_fix. No gaps.

C2 (Signatures fully specified): get_content/3 in §2 has full @spec with id::String.t(), instance_id::Ecto.UUID.t(), opts(), and all four return atoms. check_instance_match/2 in §3 has full @spec with :ok | {:error, :not_found}.

C3 (Error handling shape explicit): §3 names {:error, :not_found} as the cross-instance denial atom. §6 INV-5 table confirms it is the same atom as all other denial paths — no new error atoms introduced.

C4 (with-chain order, instance check before blob read): §4 explicitly lays out the four-step chain: get/2 (step 1) → check_instance_match/2 (step 2, NEW) → check_scan_status_clean/1 (step 3) → Repo.get blob (step 4). Rationale for inserting before scan gate given. No blob read on cross-instance denial is explicitly stated.

C5 (INV-5 preservation): §6 has a four-row table with before/after Repo trip counts for every denial class. Cross-instance goes from 2 to 1 trip; cross-tenant, never-issued, and :invalid_id paths all unchanged. Argument is present and sound.

C6 (No implementation code): No def/defp bodies, no do...end blocks. Code blocks in §5b quote existing source for context and are labeled accordingly. All new elements are @spec notation and prose descriptions of function heads.

C7 (get/2 unchanged): §6 explicitly states get/2 keeps its existing 2-argument @spec. Verified against actual source — lib/letflow/repository/attachments.ex defines get/2 with the unchanged signature.

C8 (Cross-module dependencies listed): §5a names fetch_scoped_attachment_content/3 in instances.ex as the call site, shows current and updated call with instance_id sourcing traced through the existing with-chain parameter. §10 documents the REQ-388 concurrent-run relationship (logically independent changes).

Source accuracy verified: actual instances.ex source at lines 1172-1195 confirms the current call is Attachments.get_content(raw_attachment_id, opts), the pin-match pattern described in §5b exists exactly as quoted, and instance_id is already bound earlier in the with-chain at both call sites (lines 1142, 1309) as stated in §5a.
